Name: Mushroom Grow Kits
Author: blueOstrich
Description:
The mushroom grow kits take 14 days to grow, and continue to regrow every six days after the initial harvest. They yield 6-10 mushrooms. The kits can be planted in the fall or spring. Mushrooms cannot go into the seedmaker, with the exception of the common mushroom, which still produces fall seeds. 

When are the mushroom grow kits available? 
[spoiler] 
They are available at Mrs. Raccoon's shop after completing eight raccoon family quests and attaining the Good Neighbor achievement. 

https://www.ign.com/wikis/stardew-valley/Raccoon_Family_Quests

[/spoiler]
